svg.aria-label: Diagram: four interlocking fields, Identify, Understand, Shape, Strengthen, whose shared edges form one continuous loop with no privileged start and no fixed direction, framed as a possible lens for ecosystem work rather than a fixed method. Source: conversation with Andy Claremont, Head of Ecosystem and Community, Glide.
svg.text: A possible lens for ecosystem work, not a fixed four-step method:
read it as a continuous loop, and start wherever makes sense.
how they relate to each other
loop: the fields' own shared edges; no fixed direction, no fixed start
Source: conversation with Andy Claremont, Head of Ecosystem & Community, Glide: Communitygeeks Field Note, Aug 2026.
